name: hermes-agent-vscode
description: An unofficial community VS Code extension for Hermes Agent — chat sidebar with editor-aware context, workspace file references, skills, sessions, and approval modes. Not affiliated with Nous Research.

hermesAgent.command.description: Hermes Agent CLI command. When empty, the extension uses a local mock streaming response.

hermesAgent.commandArgs.description: Arguments passed to hermesAgent.command (CLI fallback mode only). Use {{prompt}} where the composed prompt should be inserted. Default uses `hermes chat -q -v` so reasoning steps and tool calls stream into the sidebar; plain `--oneshot` output still works as a fallback.

hermesAgent.useAcp.description: Use the ACP protocol (`hermes acp`) for structured streaming of thinking blocks, tool calls, and answers. When false, falls back to parsing `hermes chat -q -v` output. ACP requires the hermes-agent[acp] extra installed.

hermesAgent.permissionReminderMinutes.description: Minutes between reminders while Hermes waits for confirmation. Set to 0 to disable reminders; reminders never answer the request.

hermesAgent.defaultMode.description: Default approval mode for new sessions.

hermesAgent.model.description: Default model label displayed in the run settings.

hermesAgent.effort.description: Default reasoning effort label displayed in the run settings.

default.name: Code Review
default.description: Review code, specs, and diffs with product-quality attention.

default.name: Brainstorming
default.description: Explore product and interaction options before implementation.

default.name: Ask Advisor
default.description: Get an advisory second opinion from a local model CLI.

hermesAgent.skills.description: Skills shown when the prompt starts with /.
